mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, config_key, value_text, value_type, reason, changed_by, updated_at FROM tenant_config_override WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid ORDER BY config_key

INSERT INTO tenant_config_override (tenant_id, config_key, value_text, value_type, reason, changed_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{key}, #{value}, #{valueType}, #{reason}, #{actorId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, config_key) DO UPDATE SET value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, value_type = EXCLUDED.value_type, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, changed_by = EXCLUDED.changed_by, updated_at = now() RETURNING updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_config_override WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND config_key = #{key}
